The name Sohan, therefore, is believed to embody these qualities and is often bestowed upon children as a source of inspiration and strength.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Sohan holds deep spiritual significance in Hinduism. It is derived from the term 'Soham', which is a philosophical concept in Hinduism. Soham represents the realization and identification of the self with the universe and the divine. The name Sohan, therefore, serves as a constant reminder to the person named after it that they are an integral part of the Divine and are deserving of love, compassion, and respect. The name is a reminder for the person to strive for spiritual growth and to keep their mind and heart focused on the eternal truth of the Self.
